description: Attach a photo to one draft (replaces its current image), so it goes out with the post. Pass EXACTLY one of image_url (a public https link to a JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF — ProductClank downloads it and keeps its own copy) or image_base64 (the image bytes, base64 or a data: URL; keep it under ~3MB). Max 15MB by URL. FREE. remove:true detaches the image instead (kind:'video' detaches a video — a draft with a video posts the video, not the image). A scheduled or live draft can't be changed (draft_locked). Then publish it with publish_content_draft.

draft_id.description: From get_content_queue or a write_content_candidates result.

image_base64.description: The image bytes, base64 (or a data:image/...;base64, URL).

name: attach_content_image
title: Attach an image to a draft
